name: Escalated BEACOPP (Bleomycin / Etoposide / DOXOrubicin / Cyclophosphamide / vinCRIStine / Procarbazine / Prednisone)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Escalated BEACOPP is highly emetogenic; give antiemetic prophylaxis before each cycle.

supportiveCare: Mandatory primary G-CSF support (high-intensity myelosuppressive regimen).
Counsel on infertility and second-malignancy risk before starting; reserve for selected fit, higher-risk younger patients.
Bleomycin pulmonary toxicity: PFTs before use, monitor for pneumonitis.
Baseline LVEF before anthracycline; track cumulative doxorubicin exposure.
monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle; expect significant myelosuppression
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each vincristine dose

drugs.name: Bleomycin
drugs.notes: Escalated BEACOPP 'B'. Bleomycin 10 units/m2 IV on day 8 of a 21-day cycle. Pulmonary toxicity risk: PFTs before use, hold for pulmonary toxicity. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: Escalated BEACOPP 'E'. Etoposide 200 mg/m2 IV daily on days 1 to 3 of a 21-day cycle (escalated dose). Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: Escalated BEACOPP 'A'. DOXOrubicin 35 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of a 21-day cycle (escalated dose). Anthracycline cumulative cardiotoxicity warn 450 / hard 550 mg/m2. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Escalated BEACOPP 'C'. Cyclophosphamide 1250 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of a 21-day cycle (escalated dose). Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: Escalated BEACOPP 'O' (Oncovin). vinCRIStine 1.4 mg/m2 IV on day 8 of a 21-day cycle, 2 mg per-dose cap (ISMP safety default). IV only and fatal if given intrathecally. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Procarbazine
drugs.notes: Escalated BEACOPP 'P' (procarbazine). Procarbazine 100 mg/m2 PO daily on days 1 to 7 of a 21-day cycle. Advise tyramine/alcohol precautions (MAOI-like). Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Prednisone
drugs.notes: Escalated BEACOPP 'P' (prednisone). Prednisone 40 mg/m2 PO daily on days 1 to 14 of a 21-day cycle. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
